name: black_friday_store
title: Black Friday Store Aisle
description: A store aisle on Black Friday, at full human scale: gondola shelves with BLACK FRIDAY header signs, hanging banners, warm ceiling light, two shopping carts and a checkout lane. Cart A's low bottom rack (top 6 cm off the floor) holds one free rigid deal box (a 14 x 8 x 3.2 cm phone box with a 70% OFF tag, 0.15 kg) where Jumper's claw can reach it. Two adult shopper figures stand at either end of Cart A, and a small shopper stands at the checkout with an empty basket on the floor. The figures are static bodies a host may animate kinematically. Robot spawn is on the floor behind Cart A.
